learning_outcomes.text: This 2nd year module aims to train students in the eco-design process of a mechanical system: from need to preliminary design, highlighting respect for the environment and the robustness of the designed system.
The teaching relies on a learning project to address all necessary competencies for implementing such an approach.

assessment_methods.method: Project based on several deliverables during the semester

assessment_rules: Evaluation is based on a competency grid.
institution: Ecole Nationale Superieure De Mecanique Et Des Microtechnique
degree: Diplôme d'ingénieur ENSMM (cycle ingénieur, spécialité Mécanique) — 1.er y 2.º año
